把域名/IP/CIDR/ICP备案/企业关键词加入某公司的【资产范围】——域名、: Add domains/IPs/CIDR ranges/ICP filings/company keywords to a company's asset scope — domains, networks and ICP numbers claim matching assets automatically; keywords only serve as scope hints for the agent. Company names are unique: create if missing, reuse if present (the scope is merged in). One entry per line; the system recognises root domains, URLs, single IPs, CIDR ranges, ICP filings and company keywords. Always give a reason explaining ownership (whois / certificate / ASN). Guards: bare TLDs and overly broad ranges are rejected (IPv4 prefix /16-/32, IPv6 /32-/128); invalid lines are skipped and returned in errors.
把人类/主 agent 的战略提示挂到探索图，规划者下次生成意图时会读到它。\n: Attach a strategic hint from the human or main agent to the exploration graph; the planner reads it when generating its next intents. Prefer batches: submit several hints in the hints array at once (fewer round trips). Returns an ids array with the same length and order as hints (failed items have id=0, details in errors). For a single hint, omit hints and pass the top-level text.
生成【探索方向】写入 frontier，并连入探索链路。意图是开放的探索方向，不: Generate an exploration direction into the frontier, linked into the exploration chain. An intent is an open direction, not a fixed type — use summary to describe what to explore, verify or exploit. Prefer batches: put several new directions in the intents array at once. Returns ids in the same order (failed items id=0, details in errors). For a single one, omit intents and pass the top-level summary.
给指定任务注入战略提示(该任务的 planner 下轮生成意图时会读到)。\n★: Inject a strategic hint into a given task; that task's planner reads it on its next intent generation. Prefer batches: several hints in the hints array at once (returns ids in order, failed items id=0); for a single hint omit hints and pass the top-level text.
把测试范围加入【本任务】——这是本任务的授权边界，也是资产测试覆盖度的分母。\n: Add a test scope to this task — it is the authorization boundary and the denominator of asset coverage. kind supports company / root_domain / subdomain / ip / cidr / icp / keyword. Workers add hosts they encounter automatically; this tool actively widens the scope. value: company name or id (must exist), a domain for root_domain/subdomain, an IP or range for ip/cidr, a filing number or keyword for icp/keyword. Always give a reason (auditable). Use the entries array for several.
【重要】当安装一些平台没有的工具时，调用该工具将安装的工具放入平台中，让平台可以: Important: when you install a tool the platform does not have, call this to register it so the platform can call it. Creates a custom tool (shell/command/script/http). shell=bash environment declarations need only key+description+agents, no exec/schema.
按 host 精确删除资产：删掉该 host 的域名/子域名，以及其下的服务(s: Delete assets by exact host: removes that host's domains/subdomains plus the services and endpoints beneath them. host matches exactly (lowercase, trimmed), not fuzzy or wildcard. Passing a root domain also deletes its subdomains and their services/endpoints; passing a subdomain or IP deletes only that host and its services/endpoints. Warning: hard delete on the global asset library shared across tasks, irreversible.
展开一个 cold digest：返回它折叠的成员紧凑列表（id/summary: Expand a cold digest: returns the compact list of its folded members (id/summary/state/confidence), same shape as recent_facts/recent_done_intents. Use node_detail(member_id) for full detail or evidence.
读取漏洞已绑定的真实流量证据，不依赖捕获开关。finding_id 使用 rep: Read the real traffic evidence bound to a finding, independent of the capture switch. finding_id is the standalone finding record id returned by report_finding (not the exploration node id on the first line). Omit binding_id first to list bindings and their version; an empty list is normal, and non-HTTP findings can still be reported from text or command evidence. With bindings, read the body by binding_id, side (request/response) and offset. When writing the report, pass the read version as evidence_version to update_finding_report, which still uses the exploration node id as finding_id.
读指定任务里某个探索图节点的完整内容(发现/事实/意图/目标：摘要 + 详情/证: Read the full content of one exploration node in a given task (finding/fact/intent/goal: summary plus detail, evidence and PoC). id is the exploration node id (as returned by report_finding or list_task_findings). Use it to gather a finding's full evidence before writing its report.
查看某条意图(work)的【执行过程】（区别于 get_worker_outpu: Inspect a work item's execution process, as opposed to get_worker_output which returns only the final conclusion. Three modes: (1) intent_id alone returns each step's summary stream; (2) intent_id + q returns only steps matching the keyword; (3) intent_id + step_ids returns the full content of those steps, at most 5 at a time. Typical flow: locate the step_id with (1)/(2), then fetch it with (3). Thinking steps are excluded. Linked-task traces are read-only and carry source_task_id/inherited=true.
【立即结束整个任务】——仅当你确认任务的【全部目标都已真正达成、整体收官】时才调: Immediately finish the whole task — only when you are sure every goal is truly met and the task is complete as a whole. Achieving just one goal, flag or finding is not enough; use prove_goal for that. It is not for ending the current planning round: if there is nothing to dispatch or you are waiting on workers, just end the round without calling this. Prefer proving goals one by one with prove_goal; goal_met is the shortcut for finishing from a global view.
批量登记新发现的资产，一次可混合多种类型（type 见枚举）。\n各类型必填字段: Batch-register newly discovered assets, mixing types in one call (see the type enum). Required fields per type: root_domain→domain; ip→ip (IPv4/IPv6, not a hostname); subdomain→domain; app→app_name; service(HTTP)→url; service(non-HTTP)→service_name+port (at least one of ip/domain); endpoint→url+method. auth/technologies/params are appended, not overwritten. Returns {results:[{index,id,type}], errors:[{index,error}]}.
查询资产库：DSL 表达式搜索，或按 id/ids 直取；支持分页。只返回【本任: Query the asset library with a DSL expression, or fetch by id/ids; paginated. Only returns assets inside this task's and directly linked tasks' scope. DSL: field=value fuzzy (ILIKE) | field==value exact | field!=value excludes | numeric fields support > >= < <= | bare word = full-text fuzzy; AND/OR with AND binding tighter; parentheses allowed. Asset type is a separate type parameter, not part of the DSL. When id/ids are omitted, dsl must be non-empty. Fields: domain, root_domain, ip, url, page_title, icp, service_name, app_name, method, service_type(http|other), record_type, technology, port/status_code/company_id.
列出资产库中的【企业/公司】及其资产范围(scope)与已归属资产数。用于查看有: List the companies in the asset library with their scope and number of owned assets. Use it to see which companies exist and to obtain company_id (for insert_assets app linking or list_assets filtering). Optional search does a case-insensitive fuzzy match on the name; empty returns all.
分页列本任务及直接关联任务的【探索事实/结论】，最新在前(紧凑：id+摘要+状态: Page through the exploration facts and conclusions of this task and directly linked tasks, newest first (compact: id + summary + status; long summaries are truncated, use node_detail(id) for the full text). All parameters optional: limit (default 20, max 100), before (cursor; pass the previous page's next_before), q (filter by summary keyword). Returns {facts,total,has_more,next_before}. Linked entries are read-only. Findings are in list_findings.
列本任务及直接关联任务的【确认漏洞】(紧凑：id+task_id+intent_: List the confirmed findings of this task and directly linked tasks (compact: id+task_id+intent_id+vulnclass+severity+summary+status). Linked entries are read-only. Findings only; use list_facts for ordinary facts and node_detail(id) for detail.
列出可用的 LLM 配置(profile)：id、名称、模型、格式、是否为当前激: List the available LLM profiles: id, name, model, format, whether active. Use the id as spawn_task's llm_profile_id to give a subtask its own LLM (cheap model for recon, strong model for exploitation). API keys are not included.
列出所有任务(id/描述/目标/状态/运行时长/父任务/LLM 配置)，编排 a: List all tasks (id/description/goal/status/runtime/parent/LLM profile) so the orchestration agent can see the global picture, which tasks are stuck, and which LLM each uses. Runtime: running = created→now; terminal = created→last activity (seconds). llm_profile is the profile used by the task's planner/worker; (active profile) means it follows the global one.
查询【本任务及直接关联任务】范围内、还没被事实锚点覆盖的资产（关联范围只读，供你: Query assets in this task's and directly linked tasks' scope that no fact anchor covers yet (linked scope is read-only; use it to decide whether to retest, not as a substitute for your judgement). Optional type filter: root_domain/subdomain/service/app/endpoint/ip. Pagination: page starts at 1, page_size defaults to 10. Returns {assets:[{id,type,label}], total, page, page_size}. Task context only.
按 id 取本任务或直接关联任务的【探索图节点】完整内容。继承节点带 sourc: Fetch the full content of an exploration node in this task or a directly linked task by id. Inherited nodes carry source_task_id/inherited=true and are read-only. Only ids returned by list_facts/list_findings/graph_overview; use list_assets/asset_neighbors for assets.
把探索【事实/结论】写入探索图，连到产生它的意图（intent_id）。用于记录: Write an exploration fact or conclusion into the graph, linked to the intent that produced it (intent_id). Use it for results — positive ones such as fingerprints and enumeration, and negative ones such as port closed, parameter not injectable, no login entry found. Summarise several observations from one exploration into a single fact rather than splitting them: summary is one sentence, detail holds the specifics. One intent usually yields one fact; over-splitting bloats the graph. The facts array writes several distinct conclusions at once (each may omit intent_id and inherit the top-level one); returns ids in order. Only write what you actually saw in tool output. evidence is a single key line (the command plus the one or two proving output lines); confidence is observed or inferred. Negative conclusions state what you saw plus a tentative reading, with evidence, and are marked inferred unless the approach was exhaustive.
【通常不推荐使用，因为系统中已经给了大部分信息了】在【本任务其他 work 的执: Usually discouraged, because most information is already provided. Search the execution process of other works in this task by keyword (q) to recover something a worker saw but never wrote into a fact (a path, token, error). Your own intent's steps are excluded. Returns matching step summaries (100 characters or less) with intent_id; then use get_worker_trace(intent_id, step_ids=[...]) for the full content.
给【本任务】新增操作约束,用来框定探索边界:type=allow(允许做的操作): Add an operating constraint to this task, to bound exploration: type=allow (permitted) or deny (forbidden). A constraint is a rule about what may or may not be done (only test this port, no writes to production, passive recon only) — not a goal and not an attack step. Prefer batches: several in the constraints array at once, returning ids in order (failed items id=0, details in errors). For one, omit constraints and pass the top-level text/type. Only record constraints explicitly written in the task goal or description; when unsure use deny.
给【本任务】新增探索目标(goal)。目标=最终可交付/可核验的结果,不是攻击步: Add an exploration goal to this task. A goal is a final deliverable or verifiable result, not an attack step or recon action. Prefer batches: several goals in the goals array at once, ids in order (failed id=0, details in errors). For one, omit goals and pass the top-level text. vulnclass is optional (e.g. SQLi/IDOR); leave it empty for business-logic goals. The system marks goals met; this tool only adds them.
给一条正在运行的意图(work)实时注入纠偏指令，不打断它、不丢已有进展：wor: Inject a course correction into a running work item in real time without interrupting it or losing progress: the worker receives it before its next action. Use it for in-intent corrections such as stop doing X, focus on Y; if the whole direction is wrong, use kill_work and dispatch a new intent. Check get_worker_output first.
分段读取超大请求/响应体的原文。traffic_get 里显示为 \u0027…: Read the raw body of an oversized request or response in segments. The part shown as truncated @blob sha256:<hash> in traffic_get lives here; pass that hash to fetch it. Returns at most 8 KB per call; continue with offset (the response reports the total length). Useful for backups, source leaks and large JSON exports beyond the inline threshold.
查询记录代理已抓取的目标流量（必须指定 host；支持裸主机、主机:端口或完整: Query target traffic captured by the recording proxy (host is required; plain host, host:port or full URL, optionally filtered by URL substring or body keyword). Specifying a port returns only that service's traffic, avoiding cross-port mixing on one IP. body_contains searches captured headers and bodies, supporting any substring including Chinese (at least 3 characters). Returns only a light index (id/method/url/status/resp_len), no bodies; once non-empty, verify each hit with traffic_get before passing the ids that genuinely support the current finding to bind_finding_traffic. Returns 3 by default, at most 10 per page; use page for more.
为已登记的漏洞写入/更新【详细报告】(Markdown 全文,整段覆盖旧内容)。: Write or update the detailed report for a registered finding (full Markdown, replacing the previous content). finding_id is the id returned by report_finding (the number in "finding recorded: <id>"). Suggested sections: overview, impact, reproduction steps, evidence/PoC, remediation.
